mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_reference WHERE file_id = #{fileId})
SELECT file_id, ref_type, ref_id FROM media_reference WHERE ref_type = #{type} AND ref_id = #{entity}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media_reference(file_id, ref_type, ref_id) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{type}, #{entity})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM media_reference WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND ref_type = #{type} AND ref_id = #{entity}
